1339-5572-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5572-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

622-757-2003-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
622-757-2003-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Contagion Engine to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

3490-4050-4506-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4506-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-4478-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

423-573-1437-3819.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-573-1437-3819.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Cultivator Colossus spell three times.
Resolve the first Cultivator Colossus copy.
The Cultivator Colossus token enters the battlefield, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield, drawing a card, and choosing not to repeat the process.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-573-1437-3819.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1170-1329-1482-4460.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6664-7175.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-6664-7175.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6438-6791.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6438-6791.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

67-2781-5256.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-5268-6702.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2079-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

474-2034-4394-4452.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

864-2593-4067-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Eternal Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Eternal Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

2816-3156-3621-4763.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3457-5329-5475.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

4636-5391-5668.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1284-3341-4828.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
Viridian Longbow attached to Charnelhoard Wurm.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1284-3341-4828.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Charnelhoard Wurm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Benefactor's Draught to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Benefactor's Draught by paying {1}{G}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{G}, this combo will net near-infinite mana.

548-2104-3212-5261.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brainstorm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put Temporal Manipulation and another card on top of your library, ensuring Temporal Manipulation is the topmost card.
Move to your turn, drawing and revealing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
God-Eternal Kefnet's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U}{U} to cast a copy of Temporal Manipulation.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brainstorm without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4050-4089-5011.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding one mana of any color.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

738-1969-3652-4050.description:
Sacrifice Ornithopter to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.

937-2358-4695.description:
During your upkeep, activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
